status: PROPOSED - no accountable owner has approved these numbers (MC-001/MC-004)

objectives.startup_latency: sandboxed launch of a static no-op workload: p50 <= 50 ms, p99 <= 150 ms on a 2-vCPU x86_64 node
objectives.availability: control API readiness >= 99.9% monthly, excluding declared maintenance
objectives.determinism: identical profile + config + release produce identical seccomp program digest and profile digest (bit-exact)
objectives.isolation: 0 escaped adversarial probes; 0 launches without kernel read-back verification
objectives.memory_overhead: host peak RSS <= 64 MiB for the launcher process
objectives.tail_latency: burst of 16 concurrent launches: p99 <= 500 ms, 0 errors
